svg.title: Moller gluing construction: sphere and numerical shrinking torus
svg.desc: Original wireframe schematic of the limiting configuration. The round sphere has radius two. The torus uses the existing numerical Angenent profile. The two highlighted circles come from the intersections of its sampled meridian with that sphere. No desingularized genus-g solution is drawn.

g.text: The interfaces are replaced in the gluing construction.
The smooth genus-g shrinker is not drawn.
SCHEMATIC • numerical torus and exact round sphere
